visualReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current portable/source-terrain frames. Individual Rio Metropolitan Cathedral has a broad approximately 107 m circular base tapering to a roughly 33 m crown at the mapped 75 m height. Gray-brown concrete horizontal louvers and narrow radial ribs form four merged grille quadrants around tall recessed dark window bands. Broad sloping borders, small rim vents, a recessed cross skylight and four simplified bronze portals/short steps complete the exterior. Separate mapped campanile has four tapering free-standing legs, six open stages, selected bronze bells and a 75 m cross envelope. Roof/pylon ends were corrected to stay within the mapped height. Source review terrain uses a bounded estimated plaza grade, with the original coarse DEM retained separately. Stained-glass art, portal sculpture and detailed interiors are excluded.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 11 current shared/geographic frames. Three existing cached 256-square plain-concrete, boardformed-concrete and cast-bronze graphs serve five merged groups. Metric UVs, linear warm concrete/dark blue-gray tints and flat architectural normals; glazing/metal accents use opaque PBR colors. No embedded images or unique facade textures. Each graph reads once; unloading disposes geometry and leaves zero live model geometries. Shared close views show concrete grille depth, inset full-height window axes, bronze portals, crown cross and open campanile stages/bells. Top placement matches the main notches and separate northwestern tower footprint. Whole views frame the model envelope; some views naturally occlude the tower behind the cone, while the opposite whole/detail views show it independently. Flat geographic diagnostic ground is not surveyed plaza fit.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all 27 current Earth-lighting frames: Economy/High, noon/late, three distances, texture-free silhouette, six details, four matched whole-model LODs and four transitions. Skyline preserves tapered cone, four window axes/crown cross and detached cross-topped campanile. District adds shared textures, 12 coarse horizontal tiers per quadrant, radial ribs and open bell stages. Street refines to 21 tiers and selected bells/portal framing; closeup/master use 33 tiers and denser ribs. Corrected dark district switching by adding five tiers within budget and using geometry-coverage color on omitted grille cells; skyline also uses the estimated facade mean. Density/pop remains deliberately simplified, with physical motion/device timings unmeasured. Four matched whole views frame the full envelope; rear tower is partly occluded from the common front camera and shown by separate opposite views. Synthetic cottages and bounded source plaza are fixtures.

Four inset window notches align paired axes; the separately mapped northwestern campanile signs placement. Internal grille/portal/skylight and tower stage/bell dimensions remain picture estimates.
